architectureTemplates.title: Hospital Information System Modernization
architectureTemplates.businessChallenge: Regional hospital chain (500+ beds) running legacy HIS on aging hardware faces: unplanned downtime costing $50K/hour, inability to scale for peak patient loads, fragmented vendor support across 8 different systems, and non-compliance with HIPAA data protection requirements. Current SAN storage reaching capacity limits with no path to scale.

solutionArchitecture.overview: Hyper-converged infrastructure with integrated security and disaster recovery for unified hospital IT operations

components.role: Primary compute and storage platform
components.specification: 3-node cluster, 768GB RAM per node, all-flash NVMe storage, 99.999% availability SLA

components.role: Network security and HIPAA compliance enforcement
components.specification: 2x active-passive HA pair, IPS/IDS, SSL inspection, micro-segmentation for medical devices

components.role: Disaster recovery and ransomware protection
components.specification: RPO < 15 minutes, RTO < 1 hour, immutable backups, air-gapped recovery

components.role: Centralized logging and compliance reporting
components.specification: Automated HIPAA compliance reports, 7-year log retention, real-time threat correlation

architectureDiagram.description: Three-tier architecture with HCI nodes hosting VMs for HIS/EHR applications, Fortinet security perimeter protecting east-west traffic between medical devices and patient data, replicated DR site for business continuity
architectureDiagram.dataFlow: Medical devices → Fortinet micro-segmentation → Sangfor HCI (EHR/HIS VMs) → Encrypted replication → DR site

keyBenefits.description: System availability improved from 99.5% to 99.99%
Annual IT infrastructure costs reduced through consolidation
Disaster recovery time objective for critical systems
Full compliance achieved with automated audit reporting

architectureTemplates.title: Financial Enterprise Workload Modernization
architectureTemplates.businessChallenge: Regional financial institution with 200+ branches needs to modernize enterprise support systems. Challenges include: fragmented CRM across departments causing missed cross-sell opportunities, manual report generation taking 2 weeks monthly, paper-based cheque processing and document workflows delaying operations, and legacy branch office infrastructure with high maintenance costs.

solutionArchitecture.overview: Unified enterprise infrastructure for CRM, Cheque Image System, Document Management, and branch office operations — excluding core banking and trading systems

components.role: Enterprise application platform (CRM, Cheque Image System, Document Management, reporting)
components.specification: 4-node cluster, 768GB RAM total, Nutanix AOS, hosts CRM/Cheque Imaging/DMS/reporting workloads

components.role: Branch connectivity and enterprise application security
components.specification: HA pair at DC, SD-WAN for 200 branches, SSL inspection for cloud apps

components.role: Development, testing, and departmental workloads
components.specification: 6-node cluster for UAT/dev, report generation, analytics sandbox

components.role: Enterprise data protection and compliance archival
components.specification: RPO < 1 hour, RTO < 4 hours, 7-year retention for regulatory compliance

architectureDiagram.description: Nutanix HCI hosting enterprise applications (CRM, Cheque Image System, Document Management, reporting), Fortinet SD-WAN connecting branches with centralized security, Proxmox for dev/test isolation, Sangfor DR for business continuity
architectureDiagram.dataFlow: Branch staff → Fortinet SD-WAN → Nutanix (CRM/Cheque Imaging/DMS) → Proxmox (Reports/Dev) → Sangfor (Backup/Archive)

keyBenefits.description: Cross-sell conversion rate improvement through unified customer view
Reduction in monthly report preparation time
Cheque image capture and processing speed improvement
Document search and retrieval speed with digital DMS
Reduction in branch office IT maintenance costs

architectureTemplates.note: Excludes core banking and trading systems — focuses on enterprise support workloads only

architectureTemplates.title: Omnichannel E-Commerce Platform
architectureTemplates.businessChallenge: National retail chain with 500+ stores needs unified e-commerce platform handling flash sales (10x normal traffic). Current challenges: site crashes during promotions costing $2M/hour, inventory sync delays between online/offline channels, POS system vulnerabilities, and inability to scale for seasonal peaks.

solutionArchitecture.overview: Scalable cloud-native architecture with edge security and automated scaling for high-traffic retail operations

components.role: Primary e-commerce platform hosting
components.specification: 8-node cluster with Nutanix Flow for microsegmentation, auto-scaling to 500+ VMs

components.role: Web application firewall and DDoS protection
components.specification: WAF for e-commerce applications, bot protection, PCI DSS compliant, 10Gbps throughput

components.role: Store-level security and SD-WAN
components.specification: 500x distributed to stores, zero-touch provisioning, local internet breakout

components.role: Store-level data protection and POS backup
components.specification: Local HCI at flagship stores for POS resilience, cloud-tiered backup

architectureDiagram.description: Centralized e-commerce platform on Nutanix with Fortinet edge security at each store, auto-scaling groups for flash sale capacity, PCI DSS isolated network segments for payment processing
architectureDiagram.dataFlow: Customer → FortiWeb WAF → Nutanix (E-commerce) → Inventory DB → FortiGate (Store POS) → Cloud Backup

keyBenefits.description: Handle 10x traffic spikes during flash sales without degradation
Zero downtime during peak shopping seasons
Infrastructure costs through consolidation and automation
Full compliance with automated vulnerability scanning

architectureTemplates.title: Global Supply Chain Management System
architectureTemplates.businessChallenge: International logistics company with 200+ warehouses needs real-time visibility across global supply chain. Current issues: 15-minute inventory data delays causing stockouts, customs documentation vulnerabilities, unreliable warehouse systems in emerging markets, and no unified tracking across ocean/air/ground transport.

solutionArchitecture.overview: Distributed infrastructure with edge computing for warehouse operations and centralized security for global connectivity

components.role: Regional data center compute for supply chain applications
components.specification: 12-node cluster across 3 regions, cross-region replication, 500TB total storage

components.role: Global network security and warehouse segmentation
components.specification: HQ pair + regional pairs, VLAN segmentation per warehouse zone, IoT device security

components.role: Warehouse-level local compute and caching
components.specification: 200x lightweight Proxmox nodes at warehouses for local WMS, offline capability

components.role: Warehouse wireless and IoT connectivity
components.specification: Secure WiFi for scanners/devices, IoT segmentation, local breakout

architectureDiagram.description: Hub-and-spoke architecture with regional Sangfor HCI clusters serving supply chain applications, Proxmox edge nodes at warehouses for local operations, Fortinet security mesh connecting all sites with encrypted tunnels
architectureDiagram.dataFlow: Warehouse (Proxmox) → Fortinet VPN → Regional HCI → Global SCM Application → FortiGate (Customs/Security)

keyBenefits.description: Real-time inventory visibility across all warehouses globally
Local processing latency at warehouse edge nodes
Warehouse operations continue during WAN outages
Reduced WAN bandwidth costs through edge caching

architectureTemplates.title: Digital Campus Infrastructure
architectureTemplates.businessChallenge: University with 30,000 students needs modernized IT infrastructure for hybrid learning. Challenges: LMS crashes during exam periods (10x load), fragmented systems across 50 departments, no unified identity management, student data privacy concerns (GDPR/FERPA), and limited IT staff supporting complex environment.

solutionArchitecture.overview: Unified infrastructure platform with self-service capabilities and automated security for educational operations

components.role: Centralized management for all campus workloads
components.specification: 10-node cluster, Prism Central for unified management, supports LMS/Moodle, student portal, research computing

components.role: Campus security and endpoint protection
components.specification: Perimeter security, NAC for 30K devices, SSL VPN for remote access, FERPA compliance

components.role: Department-level development and research workloads
components.specification: 20 department clusters for CS/engineering labs, container workloads for research

components.role: Campus-wide data protection
components.specification: Automated backup for all student/faculty data, GDPR-compliant data lifecycle

architectureDiagram.description: Centralized Nutanix cluster for core academic applications, distributed Proxmox clusters for departmental use cases, Fortinet security perimeter with NAC for campus-wide device authentication
architectureDiagram.dataFlow: Students/Faculty → FortiGate/NAC → Nutanix (LMS/Portal) → Proxmox (Dept Labs) → Sangfor (Backup/DR)

keyBenefits.description: Handle 3x exam period traffic without performance degradation
Reduction in IT management overhead through unified platform
Faculty can self-provision VMs for research without IT tickets
Automated data protection and privacy compliance

architectureTemplates.title: Digital Government Services Platform
architectureTemplates.businessChallenge: Municipal government serving 2M citizens needs to digitize 200+ government services. Current state: paper-based processes causing 4-week processing times, citizen portal on legacy platform unable to scale, security vulnerabilities in citizen data handling, no single sign-on across departments, and compliance with government security standards (ISO 27001).

solutionArchitecture.overview: Secure government cloud platform with multi-department isolation and citizen identity management

components.role: Government private cloud for all e-services
components.specification: 16-node cluster across 2 data centers, multi-tenant isolation per department, 99.999% availability

components.role: Government-grade security and compliance monitoring
components.specification: HA pair at each DC, SSL inspection, DLP for citizen data, automated ISO 27001 reporting

components.role: Centralized citizen and employee identity management
components.specification: SSO for 200+ applications, MFA for internal staff, citizen digital ID integration

components.role: Mission-critical data protection and long-term archival
components.specification: Cross-DC replication, 7-year archival for compliance, immutable backup for ransomware protection

architectureDiagram.description: Dual-data-center government cloud with Sangfor HCI hosting department-specific tenants, Fortinet security stack providing zero-trust access, centralized identity platform for citizens and employees
architectureDiagram.dataFlow: Citizen Portal → FortiAuthenticator → FortiGate (Security) → Sangfor HCI (Dept Tenant) → Nutanix Mine (Backup)

keyBenefits.description: Reduction in service processing time from weeks to hours
Citizen satisfaction rating for digital services
Mission-critical availability for 24/7 citizen services
Full compliance with government security standards
